repairs.signed_reconciliation_truth: Bounded reconciliation verifies the VideoForge signature and every tenant, attempt, token, deployment, image, model, volume, region, GPU, scratch, and nonce fact before a receipt may prove a unique provider assignment. Forged and malformed receipts are ignored as non-truth and cannot mint an assignment.
repairs.assignment_before_status: Every polled or webhook observation requires the exact current provider job assignment in the service. Additive migration 0025 makes assignment_id non-null and adds a same-tenant, same-attempt composite foreign key.
repairs.output_job_binding: When an assignment exists, provenance verification now requires exact provider_job_id equality and rejects a signed null job identifier.
repairs.paid_authority_binding: Checkpoint-generic paid RunPod authority requires typed endpoint, volume, image, and GPU resources. Every unique rate record must name an exact authorized resource; unrelated rates and junk resource sets fail closed.
repairs.result_window_and_status: Reconciliation derives the 1800-second result expiry from the persisted attempt creation time, binds any uniquely proven assignment before calling exact /status, records measured poll counts rather than caller claims, caps its deadline at result expiry, and terminally stops ambiguous work at the boundary without purge or blind resend.

remaining_gates: V2-05 still requires a separate implementation request to compose these repaired contracts into the active provider-free application/runtime path.
Hosted R2, Neon non-superuser RLS, published endpoint/image behavior, live Serverless delivery, lane timing and billing measurement, concurrency, and zero-worker drain remain later gates.

next_checkpoint.authorization: No V2-05 implementation was performed; a separate request remains required.
